title: Reuse map prefabs
summary: Save selected geometry as a prefab, place linked instances, and update their source.
outcome: A reusable prefab instance placed in the map.

sections.title: Save and place

steps.title: Save reusable content
steps.text: Select the map objects, open Create → Prefabs, and choose Save selection…. Name the .map source in the prefab library.

steps.title: Find and place
steps.text: Use Folder… if the source library is elsewhere, search for the prefab, then choose Place in view. Click a grid or camera surface; hold Shift for copies and Escape to end placement.

tips: Save the map before placing prefab instances so their source can be referenced from the map path.

sections.title: Edit an instance

steps.title: Update linked content
steps.text: Select an instance and choose Edit source. Return to the map and choose Reload to refresh the instance from that source.

steps.title: Separate a copy
steps.text: Choose Unique… to save a separate source for this instance, or Explode to turn it into editable map objects.

tips: If a prefab is missing from the browser, check Folder… and the search filter.
